integrity: The result isolates a large-order uniform asymptotic from preexisting fixed-order generating-function and Wigner formulas; none of those exact finite-order formulas is claimed as new. The proof is analytic and numerical checks are corroboration only. Publication priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: One centered single-mode squeezed thermal seed, ideal conditional photon subtraction, \(r>0\); the fixed-parameter exponential asymptotic requires positive initial thermal population and \(v<1/2\). The parity is only Wigner value at the phase-space origin. No numerical check proves the \(m\to\infty\) asymptotic.
title: High-order origin-parity crossover for photon-subtracted squeezed thermal light
